description: Watches certificate files and live TLS endpoints for expiry and identity change, and files what it finds as Oracle signals.
name: cert_sentinel

signals.description: A watched certificate's remaining life fell to the warn_days tunable or below.
signals.name: cert_expiring

signals.description: A watched certificate's remaining life fell to the critical_days tunable or below, or it has already expired.
signals.name: cert_critical

signals.description: A known certificate source now presents a different serial, issuer, or subject -- it was reissued or swapped.
signals.name: cert_changed
